Renatus' Training Trilogy

[Part I](https://voat.co/v/SavageGods/comments/834801)

[Part II](https://voat.co/v/SavageGods/comments/837499)

-----------

Renatus ducked, jumped, and dodged all of spears lunged at him. The five warriors that surrounded him couldn't even graze the armor, let alone make a direct strike. All five moved out before a volley of arrows rained down from the sky. The archers perched above were unrelenting in their shots to Renatus.

"He moves like the wind." Shozo said to Oblitus as the watched from afar.

"He ran through a constant flow of arrows down and back through a hallway without a scratch. He's close." Oblitus smiled to himself. *I might finally have a herald so I can tend to the Nusquam. That damned Ice Brain is still taxing on my power.*

Renatus grabbed a spear from one of the warriors and knocked him to the ground. The other four advanced but were easily taken. Once the archers started their volleys again, he jumped to the perches and dispatched them effortlessly, all while dodging and deflecting with the spear. "He doesn't even need the swords!" Shozo said proudly after shooting a glance at the two Bleeding Aegis swords in Oblitus' hands.

The automaton landed in front of the two and threw the spear to the side. "The task is complete, Oblitus. I have mastered your tests."

"I suppose you have. Your thoughts, Shozo?"

"Master? You think you have mastered these tests?" Shozo walked up to Renatus' face. "You must always train, never master. Once you think you are a master, you have placed a limit on your potential."

Oblitus turned his head and looked off into nothing. "Something has gone terribly wrong in Gaea. Renatus, you must travel there and retrieve one of my Lethe."

"Just one, Oblitus?"

"One is all I need." The three of them began walking to Oblitus' throne.

"I have a request as to where you will send me, Oblitus." Renatus said, sheathed his swords.

"Very well," Oblitus sat on this throne. "Go, now."

------------

The air was thin, much thinner than the dusty halls of the Nusquam. Renatus turned circles to take in his surroundings. The tall trees surrounded him and turned the forest floor green in the sunlight. The red of his armor, [the Bleeding Aegis](http://40.media.tumblr.com/tumblr_lyfaquyUh81qzkrfxo2_1280.jpg), was the complete opposite of the hue. *Yes,* he thought. *This was the area I last saw him.* Renatus jumped high into the tree branches and began to move.

When he arrived to the mouth of the cave, he heard a distinct sound buzzing through the air. He scanned the skies and saw them. Three [sentinels](http://sftdb.com/images/ma19990331_Sentinel_small.jpg) were racing through the air toward the cave. *Oblitus never said anything about trouble.* Renatus thought, his body ready for the coming fight.

The first sentinel landed in front of Renatus and shot three tentacles at him. *Spears* Renatus thought as he dodged each one advancing, one hand on the sword's hilt. Renatus covered ground and drew the sword at the last moment, cutting the sentinel clean in half. He quickly sheathed the sword when the second sentinel landed behind him and grabbed him. The gears in his arms strained as he tried to break the grasp, but the sentinel strained as well since the armor protected Renatus from being crushed.

The sentinel tossed Renatus into the rock face above the cave, but he landed on his feet when he fell to the ground. Both the second and third sentinels propelled themselves forward with their tentacles darting in and out like stabs toward Renatus. *Arrows* he thought as he swiftly dodged every attack.

Making sure not to waste a single moment, Renatus jumped over a sentinel, landed and took off sprinting in a blur. The momentum of running allowed him to slide on the ground, just under the sentinel. He caught himself on a rock and unsheathed both swords to stab the sentinel in the underbelly. Sparks flew as Renatus penetrated the hull, stood, and spread the swords outward from above him. Each half fell on the sides of him.

*Where's the third!?* he thought as he ran into the cave.

The last sentinel was towering over the sleeping [Lethe](http://www.tishthawer.com/uploads/7/9/5/7/7957899/1772370.jpg), ready to strike. Renatus lunged forward and parried the striking tentacle. The sentinel moved backward and readied it's tentacles. Its claws clamped together making spears. *Shozo* Renatus thought as he drew the second sword. Each hand was as still as the dense air within the cave.

The wait felt like eternity as the automaton and the sentinel faced each other. In an instant, both advanced. The impact of metal on metal rung through the cave, though the Lethe didn't move at all. Not even the cracking of Gaea could wake a Lethe from its sleep.

The sentinel slowly slid into two halves. Renatus stood upright and sheathed his swords. "I am not a master," he said as he began walking toward the Lethe. His walk turned to a limp, and the limp turned into a crawl. The sentinel was able to stab him in his left hip, making the leg useless. Renatus crawled to one of the Lethe and called out, "Oblitus, I have one."

A bright light illuminated the cave briefly before dulling into darkness. Two Lethe and two halves of a sentinel were all that remained.

-------------

Oblitus and Shozo ran quickly toward Renatus and the Lethe. "What has happened, my herald?" Oblitus said, kneeling next to Renatus who was on the floor.

"There were sentinels. Soulless metal creatures like myself that were trying to kill the Lethe. I defeated them."

"Why does the Lethe have that [ridiculous hat](http://i.imgur.com/78x5bTt.jpg), Renatus?" Oblitus said pointing at the head of the Lethe.

["I... I thought it would be funny."](https://voat.co/v/SavageGods/comments/835733/4151760)

Shozo had to turn away to cover his smile. Oblitus pat Renatus on his chest. "You may be of metal like the sentinel you described, Renatus, but soulless you are not."
